description: The multi-step Text to Columns wizard. Step 1 picks the split type (delimited / fixed width), step 2 configures the delimiters (or break positions) with a live preview, and step 3 chooses the target format of each produced column. The preview updates live as options change. Applying yields a SpreadsheetTextToColumnsResult. All text is localized.

parameters.name: SourceRows
parameters.description: The raw text of each source row to be split (used for the live preview).

parameters.name: OnApply
parameters.description: Raised when the user finishes the wizard.

parameters.name: OnClose
parameters.description: Raised when the dialog is dismissed.

parameters.name: RestoreFocusTargetId
parameters.description: The id of the element focus returns to on close — the host spreadsheet passes its grid root so focus lands on the grid. Null falls back to the element focused before the dialog opened.

parameters.name: LayoutMode
parameters.description: The layout the dialog renders. Auto follows the viewport scope (a sheet on the narrow one); a forced value pins the mode without measuring, so a test can render the mobile sheet without a DOM.
